recommendation_rationale: It achieved higher Primary Scored Holdout accuracy and macro-F1, lower p95 request latency, and zero observed invalid outputs or request errors in the matched complete-Corpus run at concurrency 4.
challenger_preference_condition: its substantially lower cost per correct is more important than the observed Primary Scored Holdout quality, latency, and output-adherence advantage of the recommended model.
evidence_limits: The quality headline is the 80-issue Primary Scored Holdout; the 20-issue Prompt Development Sample is not headline evidence.
The 20-issue Diagnostic Scored Supplement is deliberately selected for difficult and rare cases, so it is reported separately rather than merged into the random-holdout estimate.
Each operational result is one complete run at recorded concurrency 4; it is not a concurrency sweep or repeated-run stability result.
doctl is one representative repository. Cross-repository validation is required before a fleet-wide claim.
